title: Minefinity Redux
description: A completely revamped version of Minefinity with much better features.
body:
NOTE: This Mod is currently in Alpha

A completely revamped version of Minefinity with much better features. It will have most of the Features of Minefinity 1.50 and features from later versions.

This Mod adds the Minefinity Gems and Gauntlet from Around the Minecraft World in 80 Biomes (Please go watch it!) A new Ore: Fragments, and 3 Overpowered new swords. Much more features are planned!

These include:
- 3 Bosses (Jonathan Minecraft, Mobbo and the Minefinity Lord)
- Fragmented Forest Biome
- Temple of the Allays
- Voidstone and Voidrock
- Voidstone Meteor
- Much more to Come!
